verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The only related claims are a homepage marketing line about 'agentic automation' for KYC/AML checks and an ML fraud model (Fraud Signal). Both are adjacent automation and scoring features, not an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
